free_tier.stated: New accounts: one USD 20 trial credit, no card. The homepage may offer one sponsored starter: a 1 vCPU, 2 GiB confidential sandbox with network off that stops after ten minutes, which needs no sign-in or prepaid credit.
free_tier.notes: The USD 20 credit is a one-time account credit. The ten-minute sponsored starter is optional and appears only when the sponsored offer is available. No free recurring allowance is published.

per_object_cap.stated: Disk is 50 GB, free, at every published size from 1 vCPU / 2 GiB to 8 vCPU / 16 GiB; the per-sandbox disk cap is not stated beyond that.

retention.stated: Billing starts when the sandbox is booked and stops when it is deleted or reaches its stop time; deletion removes its files. No separate retention period for stored files is published.

egress.terms: The pricing page prices memory-hours only and states no egress allowance or per-GB price; the console lets the caller lock egress and allow hosts one at a time.

interface_detail: REST API at https://cathedral.computer/v1, the ctcli command-line client and a web console; confidential sandboxes have no SSH today and run each line of the console terminal through a line-mode terminal API.
tooling: ctcli command-line client; REST API with a cat_sk_* API key sent as a bearer token.
chaining: A paid sandbox can run an agent task and return signed command receipts; an agent can obtain a budgeted key by device login, and files must be saved elsewhere before the sandbox is deleted.

limits.value: USD 20 one-time trial credit for new accounts, no card
600 starts per minute and 1,000 confidential sandboxes at once
the optional sponsored starter is a 1 vCPU / 2 GiB sandbox with network off that stops after ten minutes

limits_note: A paid create needs a spend cap above zero and credit covering the sandbox's lifetime at its hourly rate. Per-key rate limits are not enforced yet, and a key carries an approved budget and expiry.
binding_note: The one-time USD 20 credit is what runs out first for a new account: at the USD 0.01 per hour rate it is 2,000 sandbox-hours, before the 1,000-at-once or 600-starts-per-minute platform limits.

identity_cost.detail: The paid console asks the user to sign in with Google or an email link, and prepaid credit is added by card on Stripe before the first paid create. The sign-in flow is described on the docs page; an API key for server use is created on the Keys page.

reliability_note: Several catalogue products and the pool-claim path are marked Coming soon; one-shot runs are retired; there is no SSH into a confidential sandbox today and no public hardware attestation per room, only an attestation of the machine when it joins the pool.
confidence_note: The rate, size table, trial credit, platform limits, sign-in methods and prepaid credit requirement were read from first-party pages today.

notes: The price is USD 0.0025 per GiB-hour at every size, so 2 vCPU / 4 GiB is USD 0.01 an hour and 730 hours is USD 7.30. A new account's USD 20 credit covers 2,000 hours of that size at list price. The ten-minute sponsored starter is anonymous but optional and may not be offered. The hosted sandbox needs prepaid card credit for the first paid create.

extras.price_arithmetic: USD 0.0025 per GiB-hour x 4 GiB = USD 0.01/hour; USD 20 / USD 0.01 = 2,000 hours
